task: Publish CycloneDX SBOM attestations for narwhal-portal images and align Kyverno verify-image-signatures predicateType to https://cyclonedx.org/bom (narwhal#684).

events.summary: Scope: add fail-closed CycloneDX SBOM generation (pinned trivy-action) and dual-format cosign attest (Sigstore bundle + legacy .att tag) to portal-docker-publish.yml sign job (release + sign_digest recovery); fix verify-image-signatures predicateType from https://cyclonedx.org/schema/1.4 to https://cyclonedx.org/bom; update docs, R74, R379, and lessons-log. No live cluster, GitHub, or GHCR mutations.

Live cluster read-only check confirms narwhal-portal-d74cd77bd-vltm9 (1.1.21) has kyverno.io/verify-images=fail with PolicyReport 'no matching attestations'. Source inspection of cosign v3.1.4 (pkg/cosign/attestation/attestation.go, in_toto.PredicateCycloneDX) and Kyverno v1.18.1 (pkg/image/verifiers/cpol/cosign/cosign.go matchType, pkg/engine/internal/imageverifier.go verifyAttestation) plus local kyverno v1.18.1 CLI reproduction confirm two root causes: sign job emits no cosign attestation, and Kyverno's exact-match predicateType https://cyclonedx.org/schema/1.4 can never match cosign --type cyclonedx (https://cyclonedx.org/bom).
evidence: runtime:kubectl -n devtools get pods -> narwhal-portal-d74cd77bd-vltm9 image=ghcr.io/dasomel/narwhal-portal:1.1.21 verify={"ghcr.io/dasomel/narwhal-portal:1.1.21":"fail"} and PolicyReport 'image attestations verification failed ... no matching attestations' (measured 2026-11-19)

test:kyverno v1.18.1 apply --registry against locally signed+attested image with predicateType=https://cyclonedx.org/schema/1.4 -> result: fail ('attestions not found for predicate type https://cyclonedx.org/schema/1.4') (measured 2026-11-19)
